description:
Road Trip Adventure is a racing-RPG hybrid game for the PlayStation 2. Explore a charming open world inhabited
by talking cars! Travel to new towns full of quirky inhabitants, compete in races, upgrade your car, and earn the 
chance to become the next President!

v0.2.0.description:
**Randomizer info page:**
https://github.com/Phenra/RoadTripAdventure-AP/blob/main/docs/en_Road%20Trip%20Adventure.md
**Setup guide:**
https://github.com/Phenra/RoadTripAdventure-AP/blob/main/docs/setup_en.md


### New YAML options:
- **Parts Cost Modifier**: Set a percentage modifier for the cost of parts.
- **Parts Cost Maximum**: Set the maximum cost for a part (applied after the percentage modifier).
- **Auto Unlock Warps**: Automatically unlock the warp to a town's Q's Factory when you gain access to it.
- Item and location groups added (@jack5github)
### Bug fixes:
- Shop checks can no longer be repurchased.
- Missing access rule added for the Black Opal.
- The Blue Sapphire and Fountain Pen now logically require Big Tires to access.
  - Previous logic could have expected the player to know they can reverse up the pyramids, which is a glitch.
- Client now patches vanilla game bug that causes the Space Meter to not be given to the player.
  - In the vanilla game, clearing Tunnel Race on the first try causes the game to only give the player Body Q085, and not the Space Meter. This meant the location check for the Space Meter was permanently missable!
### Gameplay changes:
- In Decorations mode, the in-game descriptions for area unlock items now show what town they unlock.
### New client commands:
- 'world_version': Displays both the version of RTA AP in use, as well as the version used during generation (if connected to a server).
- 'progressive_parts_progress': Displays the number of each progressive part received so far. Useful for determining which set to spend a hint on.
### Behind-the-Scenes changes:
- Wrote a basic MIPS encoder (not feature complete, generally only instructions I've used thus far are implemented). All game patches were rewritten to utilize it. This should make writing new assembly patches and updating old ones *significantly* easier!
  - The rewritten patches were pretty thoroughly tested, so they shouldn't cause any issues - but please let me know if you run into any problems.
v0.2.0.title: v0.2.0
